intent: Cover Thornton, CO: the Water-Wise Landscape Rebate, the citywide turf rules (front-yard cap, buffers, Minor Development Permit, build spec), the Stage 1 drought watering schedule, and how those rules reach the annexed Eastlake neighborhood.
distinctValue: Thornton is the only market city whose water utility pays toward artificial turf, and it has the metro's most detailed written turf-placement code, including the historic Eastlake neighborhood that was annexed into the city in 1990 and today carries no separate landscape rule of its own.

sources.label: City of Thornton: Eastlake Neighborhood Historic Buildings Survey (PDF)
supports: Eastlake, Colorado, a community annexed by the City of Thornton in 1990, is located in the north-central portion of the City and abuts the City of Northglenn on the west.
Due to alterations of historic buildings and new construction, no eligible historic district was found within the community.

sources.label: City of Thornton: Eastlake Residential (ER) District
supports: The ER District is intended to preserve and enhance residential areas in the community of Eastlake and to promote appropriate redevelopment consistent with the established single-family heritage and design character of the neighborhood.
Principal uses are single detached dwellings; the district's standards cover lot area, coverage, setbacks, height and building design, with no separate landscape or artificial-turf provision.
